tasks.taskText: entities no longer exports getCodePoint from src/escape.ts, a helper its earlier releases exported and code that depends on the package still imports from the escape module; today importing it gives undefined. Restore it in src/escape.ts as a deprecated export (marked @deprecated in favour of String.prototype.codePointAt): getCodePoint(input, index) returns the Unicode code point that starts at index in input, reading a surrogate pair as one astral code point, and NaN where index is outside the string. getCodePoint("abc", 0) must give 97, getCodePoint("abc", 2) 99, getCodePoint("ü", 0) 252, getCodePoint("💯", 0) 128175, getCodePoint("a💩", 1) 128169, and getCodePoint("abc", 3) and getCodePoint("", 0) NaN. What must not change: the other exports of src/escape.ts and their results (encodeXML(`'&' 💯 ü`) gives "<a href="x">'&'</a> 💯 ü" and escapeUTF8 of the same string gives "<a href="x">'&'</a> 💯 ü"), and the exports of src/index.ts, which do not include getCodePoint. The source is TypeScript in src/, with its vitest tests beside it (src/escape.spec.ts tests the escape module). Add regression tests for this behaviour to the project's existing test suite. The project's tests run with npm run test:vi.
